firstPlayerRule: The player on the dealer’s left goes first, putting down one to four cards announced as aces.
houseFallback: The page does not say who deals; use the picker.

sources.title: I Doubt It: How to Play
sources.publisher: Bicycle Cards (The United States Playing Card Company)

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards I Doubt It page. "The player on the dealer’s left places from one to four cards, face down on the table. As they put them down, the player announces that they are putting down as many aces as the number of cards."
uncertainty: The page does not say how the dealer is chosen.
